title: Google raises Pixel 11 prices by $100 and the Pixel Watch 5 by $50; the base Pixel 11 Pro and Pro XL come with 12GB of RAM, down from 16GB in the Pixel 9 and 10 (Kris Holt/Engadget)
summary: Kris Holt / Engadget: Google raises Pixel 11 prices by $100 and the Pixel Watch 5 by $50; the base Pixel 11 Pro and Pro XL come with 12GB of RAM, down from 16GB in the Pixel 9 and 10 — The Pixel 11 phones and Pixel Watch 5 are more expensive than last year's models. — Inevitably, due to soaring prices …
contentText:
Kris Holt / Engadget :

Google raises Pixel 11 prices by $100 and the Pixel Watch 5 by $50; the base Pixel 11 Pro and Pro XL come with 12GB of RAM, down from 16GB in the Pixel 9 and 10   —  The Pixel 11 phones and Pixel Watch 5 are more expensive than last year's models.  —  Inevitably, due to soaring prices …
